verdict.rationale: Docs and community evidence confirm NVLink multi-GPU connectivity (up to 4 GPUs via NVLink, HGX H200 systems with 4 or 8 GPUs), rack-scale NVIDIA-Certified Systems, and real-world production deployment (Llama 405B on H200 SXM at scale). Community corroboration (HN posts on production API and memory specifics) adds independent validation. missing for 10: independent benchmarks of full rack-scale/multi-node interconnect performance (e.g., NVSwitch/InfiniBand fabric scaling data), and no first-party documentation excerpt specifically detailing NVLink bandwidth numbers or Infinity Fabric equivalent topology diagrams.
